text: 10 OVERDOSAGE No specific information is available on the treatment of overdosage. Drowsiness and headache were reported in one patient who ingested 1440 mg of aprepitant. In the event of overdose, EMEND should be discontinued and general supportive treatment and monitoring should be provided. Because of the antiemetic activity of aprepitant, drug-induced emesis may not be effective. Aprepitant cannot be removed by hemodialysis.
